title: PHILGEPS + UNGM OPPORTUNITY BRIEFING

executive_summary.source_access_notes: PhilGEPS official public category pages were checked live on September 3, 2026 and the first visible page for each scoped category was reviewed, followed by direct official-notice rechecks for shortlisted and previously tracked candidates. UNGM public search and notice pages were scanned live through the repo runtime; no login-gated sources were used.

best_opportunities.procuring_entity: Sangguniang Kabataan ng Barangay San Antonio - San Pedro City, Laguna
best_opportunities.why_fit: This is the best new live fit today because the official abstract explicitly calls for a government website plus an administrative management system with online forms, youth registration and database features, surveys, feedback, document management, social-media integration, hosting, backups, audit trails, and future mobile-app integration.
best_opportunities.what_they_need: Public notice describes a mobile-first website and admin system using ASP.NET Core, Blazor, SQL Server 2022, role-based access, REST APIs where appropriate, cloud hosting, automated backups, logging/audit trails, document management, online request forms, youth registration/profile management, youth database, surveys, complaint/concern intake, feedback, and Facebook/social-media integration.
important_requirements: Official PhilGEPS public notice showed status Active when checked on September 3, 2026.
Official abstract shows Solicitation Number SK Resolution No. 42 S.K. 04-11 S.2026, category Information Technology, classification Goods, and ABC PHP 450,000.00.
Official public notice shows Delivery Period 3 Day/s and Closing Date / Time September 10, 2026 1:00 AM (PHT).
Official public contact shown in the notice: Maria Kryst'n A. Berroya, SK Chairperson, Alpha Base, San Pedro, Laguna, +63-63-09053110692, mariakrystn@gmail.com.

Public abstract does not expose the exact PhilGEPS membership level, detailed eligibility-document checklist, or explicit prior-project threshold; those appear to depend on the bidding documents rather than the public abstract page.
risks_or_blockers: The notice is under full Public Bidding rather than a simpler small-value RFQ, so preparation burden and formal compliance requirements are likely higher for a new supplier.
The posted Delivery Period of 3 Day/s is difficult to reconcile with the broad software scope in the public description, so implementation timeline needs immediate clarification.
The public abstract does not expose the detailed bid-document requirements, evaluation criteria, or any prior-experience threshold, so bid viability cannot be confirmed from the abstract alone.
best_opportunities.recommended_next_action: Request the bid documents immediately and confirm the true delivery timetable, hosting ownership, exact module list, data-privacy/security obligations, whether subcontracting is allowed, and the precise eligibility checklist before spending proposal effort.

not_recommended.project: Logistic & Support Services - Repair & Maintenance (Communication Equipment)
not_recommended.reason: The title initially looked service-related, but the official abstract is a communication-equipment repair-and-maintenance procurement under public bidding with hardware-focused scope and documents behind the bid package. It is not a realistic AIStaff service match.

This remains the closest live UNGM thematic fit, but it is unchanged from prior runs and still not recommended because the official notice is Spanish-language, Mexico-specific, and tied to UNDP Quantum submission for a beneficiary-facing Mexico program outside today's Southeast Asia and realistic first-entry priorities.

todays_recommendation.best_opportunity: SK SAN ANTONIO OFFICIAL WEBSITE (PhilGEPS Ref 13222790) is the best opportunity to pursue on September 3, 2026 because it is new today and directly matches AIStaff's web systems, forms, database, helpdesk-style workflow, hosting, and content-integration capabilities.
documents_to_prepare: Current PhilGEPS registration and standard government supplier registrations already on file
Business registration, Mayor's Permit, BIR registration, and signatory authority documents
Capability deck focused on government website builds, online forms, hosted systems, backups, audit trails, and support workflows
Short technical note covering hosting, database backup and restore, role-based access, support SLAs, and rollout sequencing
Portfolio examples most relevant to portals, request forms, dashboards, and citizen-facing service workflows
clarifications_to_request: Whether the posted 3 Day/s delivery period is an encoding error or only covers a kickoff milestone
Which modules are mandatory at award versus later phases, especially youth database, surveys, complaints, and admin reporting
What PhilGEPS registration level and exact eligibility documents are required for this bid
Whether prior government website or portal projects are mandatory for eligibility or only advantageous in evaluation
Who will own hosting, domain, backups, and production credentials after turnover

notes: PhilGEPS was checked only through official public pages. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, or restricted bid-document access was attempted.

UNGM was checked through the official public search and notice pages using the repo runtime. No login-gated source was used.

Previously reported PhilGEPS Ref 13220191 (Tanauan GAD database portal) remained Active on the September 3, 2026 recheck but was unchanged from prior reporting and does not yet fall within the next three-day carry-forward window, so it was omitted from BEST OPPORTUNITIES today.

Previously reported PhilGEPS Ref 13219327 (Dagupan website hosting and maintenance) now returns an official closed-notice page on the September 3, 2026 recheck, so it was removed from active consideration.
No public attachments were substantively reviewed today; only public notice pages and visible attachment or document-list references on those pages were used.
No bids were submitted, no registrations were created, and no procurement emails were sent. This run is research and reporting only.
